## createRemoteTransport() function

Create the HTTP wire transport shared by public client facades and factories. This owns credentials and canonical HTTP failures; callers own SDK codecs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createRemoteTransport(
  app: Pick<AppContract<unknown>, 'app'>,
  options: RemoteClientOptions
): RemoteTransport
```
